academy-standard.text: Clean neutral-white Academy light with restrained blue-and-gold architectural accents; faces remain natural and readable.

corridor-green.text: Use green primarily as mapped route/status illumination and reflected instrument light, never as a full-scene Fleet wash.

warning-red.text: Use red as a localized warning/status state or bright Shard marking. Do not bathe Crimson Fleet scenes in the same bright red used for Shards.
